title: [NSClient 3.0.0.2-Master] Problem using NSClient 3.0.0.2 from the latest Master version
body:
Bugs

NSClient: 3.0.0.2
Nightscout: 14.2.2 and 14.2.5
APPS 3.0.0.2-Master

Everything works fine when using AAPS version 3.0.0.2 linked to Nigtscout (versions 14.2.2 or 14.2.5). The problem occurs when NSClient version 3.0.0.2 is installed on another phone and the master profile is imported. When it starts to sync the data, the Nightscout page crashes and needs to be restarted to get it working again and pause the NSClient sync in the NSClient 3.0.0.2 app.

comments.body:
what do you mean by master profile is imported?
i tested it now on fresh ns and fresh nsclient without issue

Yes, with the current Master profile imported into an NSClient installation built with the same Keystore as the Master version.

I thought there was something wrong with the Nightscout page and I created a new page with the latest version and the same thing happens. When importing the profile, the nightscout page breaks when starting NSClient. The master version works fine after restarting dynos on heroku and pausing NSClient on the phone where NSClient is installed.

do not import master data into nsclient
just configure it for NS address
I have tried without importing the profile and after putting the data of his Nightscout page, a few minutes later, NSClient returns an error and the Nightscout page crashes.
I believe this is related to Calibrations processsing which is resolved in dev now
